summary: Practise testing wage floors, overtime, deductions, and time records. Build payroll review tools in five days. Explore the course.
lede: Wage and hour training helps payroll, HR, and employment compliance professionals review how working time is recorded and pay is calculated. Learners practise reconciling time records, testing wage-floor and overtime calculations, reviewing deduction approvals, and documenting exceptions in control registers and remediation reports, while verifying which rules apply to their organization.
audienceIntro: This wage and hour law course is designed for people who calculate pay, approve working time, investigate discrepancies, or oversee employment compliance. This course is designed for: Payroll Specialists who reconcile hours, pay elements, and payroll exceptions. Payroll Managers who approve pay-rule changes and investigate calculation errors. Time and Attendance Administrators who maintain working-time records and corrections. Employment Compliance Officers who test pay practices against applicable obligations. HR Operations Managers who coordinate pay changes and employee records. Compensation Analysts who check wage floors across pay structures. Payroll Systems Analysts who configure and validate time-to-pay rules. Employee Relations Specialists who investigate wage and working-time complaints. Employment Counsel who review documented payroll findings and legal interpretations. HR Compliance Leaders who report wage and hour risks to executives.
modules: Minimum Wage Fixing Convention Pay Tests
Protection of Wages Convention Payroll Controls
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites required. Basic professional experience recommended.
